module: Small I/O utility to save and reread logged "streams" (vehicle data streams) in three formats in the user folder: loggedStreams.json, loggedStreams.txt (wikitable) and loggedStreams.rst. The functions only read/write these files; the content generation is done elsewhere.
notes: readWikitable and readRst replace line breaks with the literal sequence \n ("huge hack" according to the code comment), so that the text can be passed as a string.
readWikitable/readRst fail (Lua error on nil) if the file does not exist, because readFile returns nil.

saveJson.desc: Writes data to loggedStreams.json (jsonWriteFile, readable format).

returns.desc: Decoded content, or nil if the file is missing

saveWikitable.desc: Writes the given text to loggedStreams.txt.

readWikitable.desc: Reads loggedStreams.txt, replacing each line break with the literal sequence \n.

returns.desc: Number of replacements (second return value of gsub)

saveRst.desc: Writes the given text to loggedStreams.rst.

readRst.desc: Reads loggedStreams.rst, replacing each line break with the literal sequence \n.

returns.desc: Number of replacements (second return value of gsub)
